description: A unilateral squat progression targeting unilateral leg strength, hip stability, and ankle mobility using a chair or bench for depth control.
setup: Stand balanced on one foot directly in front of a chair or box with opposite leg extended straight forward.
steps: Extend arms forward for counter-balance and brace your core.
Hinge hips back and bend working knee with control until buttocks touch the box lightly.
Pause momentarily without offloading weight onto the box, then press through whole foot to stand up.
cues: Descend with control without collapsing onto the box
Drive through working midfoot and heel

mistakes.mistake: Rocking torso aggressively back and forth to gain momentum off the box
mistakes.fix: Keep torso braced with steady forward lean, powering up purely from leg drive

mistakes.mistake: Working knee buckling inward upon ascent
mistakes.fix: Keep kneecap aligned directly over second toe throughout rep

rep_standard: Light tap on the box without sitting back or bouncing, standing to complete unilateral lockout
